raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: 1) From the image, ignore all arrows and focus on the structural lines and labels. 2) Expand the left AcO− fragment as CH3CO2−, which has 3 heavy-atom bonds: CH3–C, C=O counts as 2, and C–O is 1. 3) Expand the right PPh3 fragment as one P atom attached to three phenyl rings: 3 P–C bonds + 3 phenyl rings × 6 bonds each = 21. 4) Count the central transition-state core shown in the image: one single bond to the left substituent, one C=O double bond (2), and one O–P single bond, giving 4. 5) Add them: 3 + 21 + 4 = 28.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个过渡态结构，左侧标有 AcO−，中间有一个含羰基的核心结构，右侧有 O−PPh3 片段；图中还有若干弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头，只数结构中的非氢键。

推理：按指定方法处理各部分。左侧 AcO− 按 CH3CO2− 展开，并按方法草案给出的片段小计记为 3 个非氢键。右侧 PPh3 按一个 P 原子连接三个苯环展开：3 个 P−C 键，加上 3 个苯环 × 每个苯环 6 个环内键 = 18 个环内键，所以 PPh3 共 21 个键。中间过渡态核心按图中结构计数：与左侧取代基的一个单键为 1，C=O 双键按 2 计，O−P 单键为 1，因此核心为 4 个键。总数 = 3 + 21 + 4 = 28。
